Please use the app respectfully.

Helping Hand connects people who want to help with people who need a hand, in their own neighbourhood. Volunteers meet people in the street, with their consent, and list what would help. Patrons bring an item, pay for it or give towards a bigger goal, and the person confirms that they received it.
Made for IMC, built with Kotlin Multiplatform by JetBrains.

Almost all of this app is written once, in Kotlin Multiplatform, and runs on Android, desktop and the web. Only a few small things are platform-specific: the live map, the device location, the saved settings and the language switch.
